handoff: For P6-A7 (M9): preset ids, property names and data-out names are unchanged; data-error is new. Captions and announcements changed as listed in wordingChanges and in the decisions entry 'wording that lesson M9 may quote (repair after review)'. The failure note and reason sentences did not change. An instance configured on E7 or E8 now carries its data in the island, so M9 may configure one without needing the worker. Request to P1-A2 or MERGE: site/src/lib/worker.ts keeps a Worker that failed. Dropping it in onerror (worker.terminate(); worker = null) would let T13's retry after a worker that could not load start a new worker. Until then that retry waits.
